title: Library Management Domain Model

visible.label: Add stock, checkout, list member loans, and return book cleanly
visible.inputDisplay: add("111", "Clean Code", 2) -> checkout -> available==1 -> return -> available==2
visible.expectedDisplay: Counts and loan lists match cleanly
visible.script:
lib = Library(max_loans_per_member=2)
lib.add_book("111", "Clean Code", 2)
assert lib.available_copies("111") == 2
lib.checkout("m1", "111")
assert lib.available_copies("111") == 1
assert lib.member_loans("m1") == ["111"]
lib.return_book("m1", "111")
assert lib.available_copies("111") == 2
assert lib.member_loans("m1") == []

visible.label: Custom exceptions inherit cleanly from LibraryError
visible.script:
assert issubclass(BookNotFoundError, LibraryError)
assert issubclass(NoCopiesAvailableError, LibraryError)
assert issubclass(LoanLimitExceededError, LibraryError)

hidden.label: Unknown ISBN raises BookNotFoundError
Stock depletion raises NoCopiesAvailableError
hidden.inputDisplay: 1 copy checked out by m1; m2 checkout raises NoCopiesAvailableError
hidden.script:
lib = Library()
lib.add_book("222", "Python", 1)
lib.checkout("m1", "222")
try:
    lib.checkout("m2", "222")
    assert False
except NoCopiesAvailableError:
    pass

hidden.label: Member loan cap raises LoanLimitExceededError
hidden.script:
lib = Library(2)
lib.add_book("1", "A", 1); lib.add_book("2", "B", 1); lib.add_book("3", "C", 1)
lib.checkout("m1", "1"); lib.checkout("m1", "2")
try:
    lib.checkout("m1", "3")
    assert False
except LoanLimitExceededError:
    pass

hidden.label: Same member cannot check out duplicate copy of same ISBN
hidden.inputDisplay: checkout("m1", "111") twice raises LibraryError without consuming extra copy
hidden.script:
lib = Library(3)
lib.add_book("111", "D", 3)
lib.checkout("m1", "111")
try:
    lib.checkout("m1", "111")
    assert False
except LibraryError:
    pass
assert lib.available_copies("111") == 2

hidden.label: add_book tops up stock and returning unborrowed book raises LibraryError
hidden.inputDisplay: add_book increments stock; invalid copies<=0 ValueError; return unborrowed LibraryError
hidden.script:
lib = Library()
lib.add_book("9", "X", 2)
lib.add_book("9", "X", 3)
assert lib.available_copies("9") == 5
try:
    lib.add_book("8", "Bad", 0)
    assert False
except ValueError:
    pass
try:
    lib.return_book("m1", "9")
    assert False
except LibraryError:
    pass
